We got search results list of 5 templates. Need the one that when applied to target reproduces the reaction described. The precursor we have is the amine nucleophile. The template should have mapped_rxn that includes that amine fragment and a halide fragment on aromatic. Looking at first result (reaction_id 1914397) mapped_rxn shows product (product side) is the amine attached to aromatic with Br on aromatic? Let's examine: mapped_rxn: ... >> product side is ... N attached to aromatic etc. The reactant side includes Br attached to aromatic and the amine fragment (the t-butyl carbonate etc). That matches SNAr: reactants: aryl bromide + amine (the given amine). Product: aryl amine (the target). So this template is appropriate.

Thus we need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The template_id likely is the reaction_id? Or template_id is integer identifier of template used to search. In search results each entry has reaction_id and template_hash. The template_id likely is reaction_id? The prompt says "template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash)". So use reaction_id.

Thus choose template with reaction_id 1914397. Provide its mapped_rxn string.

Let's extract mapped_rxn from result: It's a long string. We'll copy exactly.

Mapped_rxn from first entry:

'[CH3:1][C:2]([CH3:3])([CH3:4])[O:5][C:6](=[O:7])[N:8]1[CH2:9][CH2:10][NH:11][CH2:28][CH2:29]1.Br[c:12]1[cH:13][c:14]([N+:15](=[O:16])[O-:17])[cH:18][c:19]2[c:20]1[O:21][C:22]1([CH2:23][CH2:24][CH2:25]1)[CH2:26][CH2:27]2>>[CH3:1][C:2]([CH3:3])([CH3:4])[O:5][C:6](=[O:7])[N:8]1[CH2:9][CH2:10][N:11]([c:12]2[cH:13][c:14]([N+:15](=[O:16])[O-:17])[cH:18][c:19]3[c:20]2[O:21][C:22]2([CH2:23][CH2:24][CH2:25]2)[CH2:26][CH2:27]3)[CH2:28][CH2:29]1'
